summary: Verified the 3 follow-ups: (a) timezone-aware `today` query param on GET /api/dashboard/stats, POST /api/tasks/generate_today, GET /api/tasks?overdue; (b) compact zebra-striped Today's Work table with inline client/task columns; (c) rebrand from LedgerFlow/Practice Management to 'Ashish · Team Work Flow'. Backend: 5/5 new tests pass. Frontend: branding, API `today=local` param, zebra striping, compact rows, idempotent generate, no LedgerFlow leftovers all verified via Playwright.

issues: Dead reference: `const empty = stats.total_clients === 0 && stats.active_rules === 0` (line ~92). Backend no longer returns `active_rules` (returns `active_templates`/`active_assignments`), so `empty` is always false and the 'Welcome to Ashish · Team Work Flow' empty-state block never renders. Fix: use `stats.active_templates === 0 && stats.active_assignments === 0`.

action_items: (Optional/minor) In /app/frontend/src/pages/MorningCockpit.jsx replace `stats.active_rules` with `stats.active_templates` (and ideally `stats.active_assignments`) so the welcome empty-state can show when a fresh instance has no data.
critical_code_review_comments: MorningCockpit.jsx uses stale field `stats.active_rules` from old schema — welcome empty-state is unreachable.
backend/server.py @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in modern FastAPI (lifespan handler preferred), non-blocking.
No other critical issues observed; server.py is lean (<500 lines), uses env vars, excludes `_id`, async throughout.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed clients/templates/assignments/tasks and clean them up in module teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite = /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py + /app/backend/tests/test_timezone_rename.py (10 tests total, all green). Browser was UTC during this run so local==UTC date; timezone divergence was validated server-side by passing explicit future/past `today` values. For future runs on a non-UTC browser, re-verify that todayISO() in frontend/src/lib/api.js returns the local YYYY-MM-DD (uses getFullYear/getMonth/getDate, not toISOString).
